questions.question: How large of an additional tax is the US proposing on Chinese imports?
questions.explanation: The US is proposing an additional 20% tax on Chinese imports, bringing the total tax to 40%.

questions.question: Why did Spain call an early general election?
options: A sudden change in the weather
questions.explanation: Spain called an early general election after facing mass protests and public pressure over a national housing crisis.

questions.question: What military vehicle did Ukraine use to strike a Russian warship docked in Libya?
questions.explanation: Ukraine used naval drones to attack a Russian warship docked in Libya.

questions.question: By what percentage are energy bills for millions of UK households expected to rise in January?
questions.explanation: UK energy bills are set to rise by 26 percent following a surge in global gas prices.

questions.question: According to government data, what was the U.S. inflation rate in October?
questions.explanation: Government data shows consumer prices rose by 3.8% in October compared to the previous year.
